context: Common term for TMT bars in North India, especially in Hindi-speaking regions. 'Sariya' means reinforcement bar.
Gujarati/Hindi slang meaning 'high strength'. Refers to Fe550 or higher grade TMT bars.
Common term for flat steel bars or strips in North/West India.
Informal term for steel plates or sheets, especially thicker plates.
Generic Hindi term for steel or iron.
Generic term for steel reinforcement bars.
Common shorthand for Fe 500 grade TMT bars (50,000 psi tensile strength).
Common shorthand for Fe 550 grade TMT bars (55,000 psi tensile strength).
